name: lkep_ctrl_phy2_ref
structural_change: Extract all remaining link parent own state into one own-clock controller/PHY hard leaf. Register per-SUB CRC-qualified valid on original capture edge, preserve packet/credit/reset/relay epochs against immutable full-core golden. Reuse former core clock entry; parent has zero own flops and sixteen total clock entries. This 216um square M5 window is an UNASSIGNED prototype until actual native parent pin and clock contract binding; no die fit claim. Actual first CTS measured 9407 roots / 11.1% utilization and TT -28.52ps rp_flat status sum, 14 levels. Compact 108um square prototype and exact same-edge carry-save/prefix sum repair the actual sparse-wire/status-add path; no clock or protocol epoch change.
